portable_principle: A Java source-root map or dormant-review result may claim only compiler-attributed Java facts from an error-free JDK compiler run; it never proves runtime reachability, safe deletion, build-tool behavior, or whole-JVM completeness.

native_model.attribution_boundary: eligible source below one inferred package root, --release 17, -proc:none, empty explicit classpath; no Maven, Gradle, module path, annotation processor, or third-party JAR model

find-dormant.claims: selected non-generated private Java methods with zero compiler-resolved MethodInvocationTree or MemberReferenceTree uses
find-dormant.dynamic_boundary: matching string literals are uncertain; reflection, DI, framework callbacks, JNI, generated source, Kotlin, external consumers, and runtime dispatch remain explicit uncertainty

map-subsystem.claims: one package directory's public declarations plus compiler-resolved first-party import and fully-qualified type edges
map-subsystem.result: durable Markdown and JSON map with source inventory, public surface, inbound/outbound edges, and unavailable fields
map-subsystem.dynamic_boundary: Maven/Gradle/classpath/module-path resolution, annotation processors, Kotlin attribution, runtime dispatch, and build variants remain unavailable

outcome_states.complete: all eligible Java source attributes with no compiler errors and no Kotlin coverage gap
outcome_states.partial: unresolved Java attribution or Kotlin source prevents a clean project claim
outcome_states.unsupported: old/missing JDK compiler, missing/excluded/default-or-mismatched target topology, no eligible source, or symlink boundary
outcome_states.failed: syntax error is non-clean and exits 2; map writes failed artifacts while dormant preserves the prior good report

closure_and_source_safety.mode: copy only the selected skill; each Java helper is a source-file launcher with no toolkit Python, shared Java runtime, sibling skill, network, or repository checkout dependency
closure_and_source_safety.source_boundary: fixture Java fingerprints and native javac checks prove analysis does not mutate source

measured_cost.focused_verification: 8 pytest cases passed in 15.24s on host JDK 17.0.12 before final integration regressions

reuse_decision.shared_candidate: JDK compiler bootstrap, path safety, source-root inventory, JSON emission, and terminal artifact plumbing
reuse_decision.reason: The map needs public-surface and bidirectional type-edge artifacts while dormant needs private-method use counts, uncertainty queues, and failed-report preservation. No cross-family repair has yet shown that a shared layer lowers maintenance cost without coupling these safety contracts.
reuse_decision.extraction_gate: Revisit only after a third accepted Java consumer requires the same copied closure and a concrete maintenance fix must be applied identically in both helpers.

coverage: positive final artifacts and source fingerprints
native javac compile before and after
malformed, unresolved, old-JDK, missing, symlink, unsafe artifact, and Kotlin boundaries

stop_decision: Do not broaden Java J4A into build-system, Kotlin, framework, or shared-runtime support in this batch; preserve the two bounded source-only pilots until product usage supplies a concrete expansion demand.
